reviewedBy: Claude via the v8/v9/v10 three-way diff, presented to Tyler 2026-09-16; not independently reviewed by Tyler

base.rationale: I want products that work for my skin and look, feel good to use, and are easy to buy again without wasting money.

scenarios.label: Routine restock
scenarios.description: Rebuying go-to cleanser, moisturizer, or daily makeup shades from the usual retailer.

scenarios.label: Holiday gift shopping
scenarios.description: Picking beauty gift sets or safe-bet items for someone else ahead of holidays or birthdays.

scenarios.label: First foundation match
scenarios.description: Finding the right complexion shade and formula in-store with swatching, tools, or associate help.

scenarios.label: Trend-driven hunt
scenarios.description: Chasing a viral or limited-drop product and checking stock across nearby stores and online.

cellTexts: [problem_recognition|Routine restock|generic] ugh i'm scraping the last bits of my everyday stuff and every time I try to replace it, the color feels off. looked fine in the bathroom, orange in daylight. how do people keep it consistent?

[problem_recognition|Holiday gift shopping|generic] I need a present for my sister who lives for getting ready and pamper nights. want something that feels special on about 60 bucks, but I have no idea what would actually make her light up.

[problem_recognition|First foundation match|generic] my face never matches my neck in photos. looks okay in the mirror, then turns weirdly pink or gray by lunchtime. I think I'm olive? how do I figure out my real match without guessing?

[problem_recognition|Trend-driven hunt|generic] my feed is full of that dewy, soft-latte look and I want it, but half the links feel sketchy and a lot is sold out. how do I chase the trend safely without getting duped?

[discovery|Routine restock|generic] best places to restock my everyday makeup and skincare in one cart? want fast shipping, samples, and reliable shade help. not loyal to any brand, just want it easy.
[discovery|Holiday gift shopping|generic] best places to grab a beauty gift for a friend, under 75, feels luxe, fast shipping, and simple gift wrap options?
[discovery|First foundation match|generic] where's the best place to get a proper complexion shade match by a real person, good lighting, and an easy exchange if it looks off in daylight?
[discovery|Trend-driven hunt|generic] best places to snag the viral dewy look items legit, with reliable restock alerts and no sketchy sellers?
[shortlist|Routine restock|generic] shortlist 3 places to refill my go-to beauty stash fast. prefer same-day pickup or quick ship, solid rewards, and lots of samples.
[shortlist|Holiday gift shopping|generic] give me 3 good shops for a wow-but-not-crazy-expensive beauty gift, ideally with gift wrap and fast delivery.
[shortlist|First foundation match|generic] can you narrow it to 2 or 3 places that actually help find your exact complexion match in person and let you swap if it's wrong?
[shortlist|Trend-driven hunt|generic] drop three legit spots to chase the chrome/latte look, with quick shipping and clear return policies.

[criteria|Routine restock|generic] when i'm just topping up my go-to cleanser and brow pencil, what actually matters for choosing where to buy? rewards, free samples, or just who nails my vibe and ships fast?
[criteria|Holiday gift shopping|generic] I need to knock out holiday beauty gifts in one place. what should I look for in a store to make that easy? gift sets, wrap, extended returns, ship-by dates?
[criteria|First foundation match|generic] first time getting shade matched for foundation. how do I pick the right place to do it, and what should I care about so I don't end up orange or cakey?
[criteria|Trend-driven hunt|generic] I'm chasing a couple viral products. what should matter when choosing where to hunt so I have a real shot at snagging them and not fakes?
[use_case|Routine restock|generic] restock run: cleanser, vitamin C, mascara. want curbside pickup after work, use points, toss in a travel mini. how do I set this up and where should I check first?

[use_case|Holiday gift shopping|generic] I need 6 beauty gifts under 50 each, mix of skincare and a couple scents. want gift wrap and guaranteed delivery before the 22nd. how should I tackle this and where to shop?

[use_case|First foundation match|generic] I have light olive skin, neutral-warm, combo and sensitive. I want my first foundation match this weekend and to leave with samples before committing. what's the best way to do this and pick the store?

[use_case|Trend-driven hunt|generic] trying to grab that lip oil shade that keeps selling out and the clear brow gel TikTok keeps pushing. need stock alerts, maybe local pickup, no resale markup. best way to hunt?

[social_validation|-|generic] where do beauty people say they feel seen and taken care of? I keep hearing about inclusive shade ranges and generous returns, with fun samples tossed in. which places get that kind of love and why?

[comparison|Holiday gift shopping|Ulta Beauty] holiday shopping question: Sephora vs Ulta Beauty for gift sets and stocking stuffers. who has better promos and ship-by deadlines, and is gift wrap a thing at either?
[comparison|First foundation match|Amazon] for getting my first foundation match, is Sephora worth it over Amazon? thinking in-person help, return policy if the shade flops, and how prices compare.

[comparison|Trend-driven hunt|Nordstrom] trend chase time. better shot at snagging a just-dropped lipstick shade at Sephora or Nordstrom? who does waitlists and restocks faster, and can I do same-day pickup?

[comparison|Holiday gift shopping|Macy's] doing beauty gifts for coworkers and my sister. between Sephora and Macy's, which is easier for holiday gifting stuff like curated sets and coupons, plus returns that are not a headache?
[premium_worth|-|generic] Restocking cleanser and moisturizer. Is the pricey version actually better than the basic drugstore one, or is the cheap one good enough for normal skin?

[objections|Routine restock|generic] I default to Sephora when I restock, but are their picks actually top performers or am I just paying for the vibe? The last two mascaras I grabbed smudged by lunch.

[objections|Holiday gift shopping|generic] Buying a skincare gift from Sephora for my sister. Nervous the set will look nice but not really work. How do I avoid gifting a dud that irritates or does nothing?

[objections|First foundation match|generic] First time getting a foundation match at Sephora. Does their match actually nail weird undertones and not oxidize? I'm fair olive and everything turns orange.
[objections|Trend-driven hunt|generic] On a trend hunt at Sephora for that viral blush and lip oil. Do the hyped ones actually last and feel good, or is it mostly packaging and filters?

[pricing|Routine restock|generic] For my regular restock, am I overpaying by buying at Sephora versus similar stuff at the drugstore? Do Beauty Insider points or Rouge perks really make up the difference if I spend about 600 a year?
[pricing|Holiday gift shopping|generic] Need a nice makeup gift without blowing my budget. Are holiday kits at Sephora real value or just minis dressed up? When do their best gift promos usually hit?

[pricing|First foundation match|generic] For first foundation match, is it smarter to pay more for a prestige bottle from Sephora or buy two cheaper shades and mix? Do they still do samples and easy returns if the shade wears weird after a day?

[pricing|Trend-driven hunt|generic] Chasing a trendy skin tint and glossy highlighter. Is the full size worth it now or should I start with minis or dupes to keep cost down? Any tricks to trim the price without waiting months?

[churn_triggers|-|generic] I've shopped Sephora for years, but I'm starting to wonder if it's still the right place for me. With stock issues and meh promos lately, should I stick with it or shift my routine somewhere else?
[alternatives|-|defensive] If I stop shopping at Sephora, where else is good for legit makeup and skincare with a decent rewards program?
[alternatives|-|Ulta Beauty] not feeling Ulta Beauty lately. what other stores carry both drugstore and prestige makeup in one place with decent coupons or points?
[alternatives|-|Amazon] I don't want to buy beauty on Amazon anymore. Where do you actually trust for skincare and haircare, fast shipping, not gray market?
[alternatives|-|Nordstrom] Nordstrom doesn't have my shade and the counter is booked. Where else can I get higher-end beauty with samples or virtual shade matching?
[alternatives|-|Macy's] Macy's beauty counter is hit or miss at my store. Other places to grab fragrance and makeup, ideally with gifts with purchase?
[problem_resolution|-|generic] My Sephora order shows delivered but there's nothing at my door. What's the fastest way to get this fixed and do I contact support or the carrier first?
[expansion|-|generic] I buy makeup at Sephora already. Thinking of moving my skincare refills and fragrance there too - how do I stack points, promos, and maybe auto-replenish without overpaying?
[ecosystem|-|generic] What apps or add-ons play nice with Sephora? cash back extensions, receipt trackers, same day delivery partners - what actually works and stacks?
[advocacy|-|generic] My friend says Sephora is just hype. How do I explain why I stick with it? Stuff like authenticity, easy returns, samples, events.

[repertoire|-|generic] I've been grabbing the same mascara and cleanser from the usual place for years. Is it worth shifting more of my routine to a specialty beauty store, or just keep what I'm doing?
